bryce: onboarding BryceCorp LoRA merge to sandbox. quick fail: embedding recall down vs base on faq anchors after OPTQ int4 step. opening thread for triage.

emma: artifacts uploaded https://internal.redwood/quick-evals/1867890123 — embed_recall 0.87 -> 0.73, mean cosine delta -0.14. :thinking_face: 

vishal: ran a tiny repro, noticed tokenizer differences around abbreviations and decimal points. example: 

```
orig: "Qty: 3.0 units"
tokens(base): [400, 120, 45, 33]
tokens(bryce-lora): [400, 120, 45321, 33]  // decimal glued to number in adapter tokenizer
```

vishal: also tested no-quant vs OPTQ int4: no-quant delta ~0.02, OPTQ int4 delta ~0.14. looks like quant amplifies the drift.

qa-bot: [auto] quickpack finished: /artifacts/1867890123/quickpack.json — gen metrics OK; embedding_recall FAILED (delta -0.14). Reranker passrate 0.95 -> 0.68.

bryce: options: (1) quick tokenizer shim mapping decimals/abbrev, (2) deploy bnb int8 for this customer, (3) re-export adapter with prod tokenizer and re-run, (4) short anchor-finetune on customer FAQ anchors.

emma: i'll prototype tokenizer shim and add token-diff CI check. will open PR and include failing examples.

vishal: i'll run quant matrix after PR lands (optq-int4 fold-v2.3, bnb-int8) and post per-config quickpack diffs. repro command: 

```
./run_quick_eval.sh --model bryce-lora:v1 --quant optq-int4 --dataset cust_faqs --seed 13 --limit 30
```

bryce: timeline: get shim PR in 24h, re-run canary across int4/int8, evaluate 100-step anchor-finetune if needed, decide mitigation within 48h. tagging @eng-ml @customer-success. :thumbsup:
